subject: Startups
title: The Growth Team Model
description: A 60-second lesson on The Growth Team Model.

hook.text: In 2008, Facebook created the first dedicated growth team. It was a new kind of unit: half engineering, half marketing.

buildup.text: Led by Chamath Palihapitiya, the team focused on one thing: getting users to experience the product's core value fast.

discovery.text: They found that users who added 7 friends in 10 days stayed. So they rebuilt onboarding around that single insight.

twist.text: The growth team had engineers, not just marketers. They could ship code changes, not just slide decks.

climax.text: Facebook's growth team helped it reach a billion users. Now every major tech company has copied the model.

punchline.text: Growth isn't a department. It's an engineering problem.

quiz.question: Who led Facebook's original growth team?
